SELECT 
  AVG(s5.count_items) as avg_count,
  AVG(s5.ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(s5.difference) as avg_difference
FROM (
  SELECT 
    s3.product_color,
    s3.count_items,
    s3.ratio,
    s3.count_items - s4.avg_count as difference
  FROM (
    SELECT 
      p.product_color,
      COUNT(*) as count_items,
      CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili2 JOIN Products p2 ON ili2.product_id = p2.product_id) as ratio
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
    JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_color
  ) s3
  CROSS JOIN (
    SELECT AVG(count_items) as avg_count
    FROM (
      SELECT 
        p.product_color,
        COUNT(*) as count_items
      FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili
      JOIN Products p ON ili.product_id = p.product_id
      GROUP BY p.product_color
    )
  ) s4
  WHERE s3.count_items > s4.avg_count
) s5
